107-BET. Unit 15 'Take a Break' — Present Perfect (yet/just/for/since).

13-mashq — Toni va Annning Parijdagi ro'yxati. Jadvalda YETTI band bor, kitobda ikkitasi belgilangan (visit the Eiffel Tower = ✓, go to Versailles = ✗). Qolgan BESh band faqat kassetada aytiladi — bu audio hisobotida qayd etilgan.

15-mashq (for/since) tekshirildi: since Friday, for three years, for ten years, since 1987, since last Monday.
  ⚠ Qoida: FOR — davomiylik (three years, ten years); SINCE — boshlanish nuqtasi (Friday, 1987, last Monday).

16a — Madriddagi dialog, 18 ta fe'l shakli tekshirildi.

⚠ 10-BAND — NOZIK JOY: 'Have you BEEN to Palacio Real yet?' Qavsda '(you/go)' berilgan, lekin javob 'been' bo'ladi.
  Sabab: 'have GONE to' = ketgan va hali o'sha yerda; 'have BEEN to' = borib kelgan.
  Savol 'ko'rdingmi?' ma'nosida, shuning uchun BEEN.
  ⚠ Xuddi shu qoida Workbook 60-betdagi 6-mashqda ham bor.

⚠ KIM HAQIDA: 16b savollarida 'he' — PAULni bildiradi. Dialogda ikki odam bor va ikkalasi ham ma'lumot beradi, shuning uchun chalkashish oson:
  PETER — shanba kuni kelgan, Monaco mehmonxonasida turibdi
  PAUL — dushanbadan beri shu yerda, do'sti Karlosnikida turibdi, Prado va Palacio Real'da bo'lgan, xarid qilmagan, kechqurun operaga boradi
  ⚠ 16b ning oltala savoli ham PAUL haqida.

⚠ JOY NOMLARI TO'G'RI YOZILGAN: Prado Museum, Palacio Real, Rastro flea market, 'Lhardy' restorani (Madriddagi eng qadimiy restoranlardan biri, 1839-yilda ochilgan), 'Carmen' operasi.
audioRequiredUz: 13-mashqning 7 qatoridan 2 tasi kitobda berilgan (Eiffel Tower ✓, Versailles ✗), qolgan 5 tasi FAQAT AUDIODAN aniqlanadi — betning hech yerida yozilmagan, taxmin bilan to'ldirilmadi. 16-mashqda ham 'listen' deyilgan, lekin dialog TO'LIQ bosilgan va zamonlar matnning o'zidan aniqlanadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: Toni va Enn Parijda ta'tilda.

JADVALDA YETTI ISh:
  visit the Eiffel Tower
  go to Versailles
  go shopping at the Galleries Lafayette
  see the Arc de Triomphe
  go on a boat trip on the Seine
  visit the Louvre
  see Notre Dame


KITOB IKKI QATORNI TO'LDIRIB BERGAN:
  visit the Eiffel Tower  →  ✓ (qilishgan)
  go to Versailles        →  ✗ (qilishmagan)

  Qolgan BESh qator faqat AUDIODAN
  aniqlanadi (quyidagi alohida ro'yxatga
  qarang).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  SA: Have they visited the Eiffel Tower YET?
  SB: Yes, they have ALREADY visited the
      Eiffel Tower. Have they been to
      Versailles YET?
  SA: No, they HAVEN'T been to Versailles YET.


IKKI QOLIP:

  ✓ bo'lsa:
     'Have they [V3] ... YET?'
     'Yes, they have ALREADY [V3] ...'

  ✗ bo'lsa:
     'Have they [V3] ... YET?'
     'No, they HAVEN'T [V3] ... YET.'


⚠ 'YET' va 'ALREADY' NING O'RNI —
NAMUNADA ANIQ KO'RINADI:

  SAVOLDA:  'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA
     'Have they visited the Eiffel Tower YET?'

  TASDIQ JAVOBDA:  'already' — 'have' va V3
     ORASIDA
     'they have ALREADY visited ...'

  INKOR JAVOBDA:  'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA
     'they haven't been to Versailles YET.'


PARIJDAGI YETTI JOY — NIMA EKANI:

  the Eiffel Tower — Eyfel minorasi (1889)
  Versailles — Versal saroyi (Parij tashqarisida)
  the Galleries Lafayette — mashhur universmag
  the Arc de Triomphe — Zafar arki
  the Seine — Sena daryosi
  the Louvre — Luvr muzeyi (Mona Liza shu yerda)
  Notre Dame — Notr-Dam sobori


DIQQAT — FE'LLARNING V3 ShAKLI:
  visit  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri fe'l)
  go     →  BEEN / GONE
  see    →  SEEN

  DIQQAT: 'go to Versailles' savolda
  'have they BEEN to Versailles' bo'ladi —
  chunki ular u yerdan QAYTGAN bo'lardi.
  ('have they GONE' = hali u yerda degani.)

  Kitobdagi namuna aynan shunday:
  'Have they BEEN to Versailles yet?'


RASM:
  Eyfel minorasi va oldidagi favvoralar
  (Trocadéro bog'idan ko'rinish).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an activity   = mashg'ulot, ish
  to tick       = ✓ qo'ymoq
  a cross       = ✗ belgisi
  the Eiffel Tower = Eyfel minorasi
  a tower       = minora
  to go shopping = xarid qilgani bormoq
  an arch       = ark, tok
  a boat trip   = qayiqda sayohat

items.whyUz:
KITOBDA ✓ ALLAQACHON QO'YILGAN (namuna).

Namuna dialogda ham tasdiqlanadi:
'Yes, they have ALREADY visited the Eiffel
Tower.'

TO'LIQ GAP:
They have already visited the Eiffel Tower.

KITOBDA ✗ ALLAQACHON QO'YILGAN (namuna).

Namuna dialogda ham tasdiqlanadi:
'No, they HAVEN'T been to Versailles YET.'

DIQQAT: savolda 'go' emas, 'BEEN' ishlatiladi
('have they GONE' = hali u yerda degani).

TO'LIQ GAP:
They haven't been to Versailles yet.

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use JUST in statements to show that an
    action finished only A FEW MINUTES EARLIER.'

 MISOL:
    A: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
    B: Yes, I've JUST packed it.


'JUST' NING MA'NOSI:
  'just' = hozirgina, endigina

  Harakat BIR NECHA DAQIQA oldin tugagan.

     'I've JUST arrived.'    = hozirgina keldim
     'She's JUST left.'      = u endigina ketdi
     'We've JUST finished.'  = endigina
                               tugatdik


QAYERDA TURADI:
  'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     'I've JUST packed it.'  ✓
     'I've packed it JUST.'  ✗
     'JUST I've packed it.'  ✗

  Xuddi 'already' kabi.


UCh RAVIShNI SOLIShTIRING:

  JUST     — hozirgina (bir necha daqiqa
             oldin)
             'I've just packed it.'

  ALREADY  — allaqachon (kutilganidan
             ertaroq)
             'I've already packed it.'

  YET      — hali (kutilayotgan, lekin hali
             bo'lmagan)
             'I haven't packed it yet.'

  Hammasi Present Perfect bilan.
  JUST va ALREADY — TASDIQDA, o'rtada.
  YET — SAVOL/INKORDA, gap oxirida.


DIQQAT — 'JUST' NING BOShQA MA'NOLARI:
  'just' — faqat (only)
     'I have JUST one question.'
  'just' — aynan
     'That's JUST what I wanted.'
  'just' — shunchaki
     'The food was JUST delicious.'
     (105-betdagi Jekning xatidan!)

  Present Perfect bilan esa 'hozirgina'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  just    = hozirgina, endigina
  earlier = oldinroq
  to pack = (yukni) yig'moq

points.en: We use just in statements to show that an action finished only a few minutes earlier.
points.uz: JUST ni harakat bir necha daqiqa oldin tugaganini ko'rsatish uchun darak gaplarda ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
'just' = hozirgina, endigina.
'have' va V3 ORASIDA turadi.

points.en: A: Have you packed your suitcase yet?  B: Yes, I've just packed it.
points.uz: A: Chamadoningizni yig'ib bo'ldingizmi? B: Ha, hozirgina yig'dim.
points.noteUz:
Savolda YET (gap oxirida),
javobda JUST (have va V3 orasida).

exercises.instructionEn: Work in pairs. Use the prompts to ask and answer questions with yet and just, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ishlang. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib namunadagidek yet va just bilan savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh KO'RSATMA:
  1  book a table
  2  pack our swimming costumes
  3  find the tickets
  4  talk to the receptionist
  5  meet Steve


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Have you BOOKED a table YET?
  SB: Yes, I've JUST BOOKED it.


QOLIP:
  SA: Have you [V3] ... YET?
  SB: Yes, I've JUST [V3] it/them/him.


BARCHA BESh DIALOG:

 1  SA: Have you BOOKED a table YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST BOOKED it.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  SA: Have you PACKED our swimming costumes
        YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST PACKED THEM.

 3  SA: Have you FOUND the tickets YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST FOUND THEM.

 4  SA: Have you TALKED to the receptionist
        YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST TALKED to HIM.
        (yoki 'to HER')

 5  SA: Have you MET Steve YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST MET HIM.


⚠ ENG NOZIK QISM — OLMOSh TO'G'RI TANLANIShI:

  BIRLIK narsa    →  IT
     'a table'         → it

  KO'PLIK narsa   →  THEM
     'swimming costumes' → them
     'the tickets'       → them

  ERKAK odam      →  HIM
     'the receptionist' → him (yoki her)
     'Steve'            → him

  Bu — mashqning eng ko'p xato qilinadigan
  joyi!


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  book  →  booked  →  BOOKED   (to'g'ri)
  pack  →  packed  →  PACKED   (to'g'ri)
  find  →  found   →  FOUND    (V2 = V3)
  talk  →  talked  →  TALKED   (to'g'ri)
  meet  →  met     →  MET      (V2 = V3)


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI PREDLOG:
  'talk TO the receptionist'
  'to talk TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.

  Javobda ham saqlanadi:
     'I've just talked TO him.'


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDA PREDLOG YO'Q:
  'MEET Steve' — predlogsiz.
     'meet somebody'  ✓
     'meet WITH somebody' — amerikacha,
        rasmiy uchrashuv uchun

  Javobda: 'I've just met HIM.'


VAZIYAT — BU DIALOGLAR NIMA HAQIDA:
  Beshala ko'rsatma TA'TILGA TAYYORGARLIK
  haqida:
     stol band qilish (restoranda)
     cho'milish kiyimlarini yig'ish
     chiptalarni topish
     administrator bilan gaplashish
     Stiv bilan uchrashish

  Ya'ni ikki kishi jo'nashdan oldin
  ro'yxatni tekshirmoqda.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to book a table   = stol band qilmoq
  a swimming costume = cho'milish kiyimi
  to find           = topmoq (find → FOUND)
  a ticket          = chipta
  a receptionist    = administrator
  to meet           = uchrashmoq (meet → MET)

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use FOR to express DURATION.'
      I've been here FOR five days.

 • 'We use SINCE to state a STARTING POINT.'
      I've been here SINCE Monday.


ENG ODDIY FARQ:

  FOR    +  QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
            for five days
            for two years
            for a long time
            for ten minutes

  SINCE  +  QAChONDAN BERI (boshlanish nuqtasi)
            since Monday
            since 1987
            since last week
            since I was a child


QANDAY ESLAB QOLISh:

  Savol bering: 'QANChA VAQT?' yoki
  'QAChONDAN BERI?'

     'five days'  → qancha vaqt?  → FOR
     'Monday'     → qachondan?    → SINCE
     'two years'  → qancha vaqt?  → FOR
     '1987'       → qachondan?    → SINCE

  Ya'ni:
     RAQAM + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     ANIQ NUQTA (kun, sana, yil)  →  SINCE


MISOLLAR YONMA-YON:

  FOR                    SINCE
  ─────────────────      ──────────────────
  for three days         since Monday
  for two years          since 2010
  for a week             since last week
  for ten minutes        since 5 o'clock
  for a long time        since I came here
  for ages               since my birthday

  DIQQAT — 'a week' va 'last week':
     FOR a week    = bir hafta davomida
     SINCE last week = o'tgan haftadan beri


DIQQAT — 'SINCE' + TO'LIQ GAP:
  'since' dan keyin GAP ham kelishi mumkin:
     'I've been here SINCE I ARRIVED.'
     'I haven't seen him SINCE HE LEFT.'

  Bunda gap PAST SIMPLE da bo'ladi.


IKKALASI HAM PRESENT PERFECT BILAN:
  'I've been here for five days.'  ✓
  'I am here for five days.'  — boshqa ma'no
                                (reja)
  'I was here for five days.' — o'tmish
                                (tugagan)

  Present Perfect — harakat HALI DAVOM
  etayotganini ko'rsatadi.


DIQQAT — 'FOR' TUShIRIB QOLDIRILIShI MUMKIN:
  'I've been here (for) five days.'
  Og'zaki nutqda 'for' ba'zan tushiriladi.
  'since' esa HECH QAChON tushirilmaydi.


DIQQAT — 'AGO' BILAN ADAShTIRMANG:
  'five days AGO'  →  PAST SIMPLE
     'I arrived five days ago.'
  'FOR five days'  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've been here for five days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'besh kun' haqida, lekin
  zamonlari BOSHQA.


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI XAT:
  'I've been here SINCE MONDAY.'
  Jekning xati aynan shu qurilmani
  ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  duration       = davomiylik
  a starting point = boshlanish nuqtasi
  for            = ... davomida
  since          = ... dan beri

points.en: We use for to express duration.  —  I've been here for five days.
points.uz: FOR ni davomiylikni bildirish uchun ishlatamiz. — Besh kundan beri shu yerdaman.
points.noteUz:
FOR + QANCHA VAQT:
for five days, for two years, for a long time.

points.en: We use since to state a starting point.  —  I've been here since Monday.
points.uz: SINCE ni boshlanish nuqtasini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. — Dushanbadan beri shu yerdaman.
points.noteUz:
SINCE + ANIQ NUQTA:
since Monday, since 2010, since last week.

105-betdagi Jekning xatida ham bor edi.

points.en: for three days / for two years / for a week   —   since Monday / since 2010 / since last week
points.uz: uch kun davomida / ikki yil davomida — dushanbadan beri / 2010-yildan beri
points.noteUz:
Savol bering: 'QANCHA VAQT?' → FOR;
'QACHONDAN BERI?' → SINCE.

points.en: I've been here since I arrived. I haven't seen him since he left.
points.uz: Kelganimdan beri shu yerdaman. U ketganidan beri uni ko'rmadim.
points.noteUz:
'since' dan keyin TO'LIQ GAP ham kelishi
mumkin — bunda gap PAST SIMPLE da.

exercises.instructionEn: Expand the notes into sentences using for or since.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa yozuvlarni for yoki since bilan to'liq gaplarga aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  He/be in Cairo/Friday
    → He HAS BEEN in Cairo SINCE Friday.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  He/live in Rome/three years
    → He HAS LIVED in Rome FOR three years.

 3  I/not see/Jane/ten years
    → I HAVEN'T SEEN Jane FOR ten years.

 4  I/not travel/by plane/1987
    → I HAVEN'T TRAVELLED by plane SINCE 1987.

 5  They/be/on holiday/last Monday
    → They HAVE BEEN on holiday SINCE last
      Monday.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  U juma kunidan beri Qohirada.
 2  U uch yildan beri Rimda yashaydi.
 3  Jeynni o'n yildan beri ko'rmaganman.
 4  1987-yildan beri samolyotda
    sayohat qilmaganman.
 5  Ular o'tgan dushanbadan beri ta'tilda.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — OXIRGI QISMGA QARANG:

  1  'Friday'      → KUN → SINCE
  2  'three years' → QANCHA VAQT → FOR
  3  'ten years'   → QANCHA VAQT → FOR
  4  '1987'        → YIL → SINCE
  5  'last Monday' → ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE

  Ya'ni:
     FOR — 2, 3 (raqam + vaqt birligi)
     SINCE — 1, 4, 5 (kun, yil, aniq nuqta)


QISQA YOZUVNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh —
NIMA QO'ShILADI:

  1) HAVE / HAS
     ega III shaxs birlik bo'lsa → HAS
     (1, 2-bandlar: 'He')
     qolganlarida → HAVE
     (3, 4-bandlar: 'I'; 5-band: 'They')

  2) FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3)
     be    → BEEN
     live  → LIVED
     see   → SEEN
     travel → TRAVELLED

  3) 'NOT' bo'lsa → HAVEN'T / HASN'T
     (3, 4-bandlar)

  4) FOR yoki SINCE


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'He/be in Cairo/Friday'
    ega 'He' → HAS
    be → BEEN
    'Friday' → kun → SINCE
    → 'He HAS BEEN in Cairo SINCE Friday.'

 2  'He/live in Rome/three years'
    ega 'He' → HAS
    live → LIVED (to'g'ri fe'l)
    'three years' → davomiylik → FOR
    → 'He HAS LIVED in Rome FOR three years.'

 3  'I/not see/Jane/ten years'
    ega 'I' → HAVE, 'not' bor → HAVEN'T
    see → SEEN
    'ten years' → davomiylik → FOR
    → 'I HAVEN'T SEEN Jane FOR ten years.'

 4  'I/not travel/by plane/1987'
    ega 'I' → HAVEN'T
    travel → TRAVELLED
       (britancha: L IKKILANADI!)
    '1987' → yil → SINCE
    → 'I HAVEN'T TRAVELLED by plane SINCE
       1987.'

 5  'They/be/on holiday/last Monday'
    ega 'They' → HAVE
    be → BEEN
    'last Monday' → aniq nuqta → SINCE
    → 'They HAVE BEEN on holiday SINCE last
       Monday.'


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'TRAVELLED':
  BRITANCHA:  travel → TRAVELLED (LL)
  AMERIKACHA: travel → TRAVELED  (L)

  Enterprise — britancha kitob, shuning uchun
  IKKI 'L'.

  Shu kabi: cancel → cancelled,
  quarrel → quarrelled.


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-BANDLAR INKORDA:
  'I HAVEN'T seen Jane FOR ten years.'
  = o'n yildan beri ko'rmadim (va hozir ham
    ko'rmayapman)

  INKOR gapda ham 'for/since' ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — 'BY PLANE':
  'travel BY plane / BY car / BY train / BY
   bus'
  Transport vositasi 'BY' bilan, ARTIKLSIZ.

  ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' (piyoda) — 'by foot'
  XATO.


DIQQAT — 'ON HOLIDAY':
  'They have been ON HOLIDAY.'
  'on holiday' — turg'un ibora, artiklsiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to expand    = kengaytirmoq
  notes        = qisqa yozuvlar
  Rome         = Rim
  to travel    = sayohat qilmoq
  by plane     = samolyotda
  on holiday   = ta'tilda

items.sentence: 1  He/be in Cairo/Friday  →  He has been in Cairo ............ Friday.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.

'Friday' — HAFTA KUNI, ya'ni ANIQ NUQTA
→ SINCE.

Savol: 'qachondan beri?' → juma kunidan.

be → BEEN (V3).

items.sentence: 2  He/live in Rome/three years  →  He has lived in Rome ............ three years.
items.uz: U uch yildan beri Rimda yashaydi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'three years' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI,
ya'ni DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

Savol: 'qancha vaqt?' → uch yil.

live → LIVED (to'g'ri fe'l).
ega 'He' → HAS.

items.sentence: 3  I/not see/Jane/ten years  →  I haven't seen Jane ............ ten years.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'ten years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

DIQQAT: 'not' bor, demak HAVEN'T.
see → SEEN (V3).

INKOR gapda ham 'for' ishlatiladi:
'I haven't seen Jane FOR ten years.'
= o'n yildan beri ko'rmadim.

items.sentence: 4  I/not travel/by plane/1987  →  I haven't travelled by plane ............ 1987.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'1987' — YIL, ya'ni ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

Savol: 'qachondan beri?' → 1987-yildan.

DIQQAT — YOZILISHI:
travel → TRAVELLED (britancha, IKKI 'L')
travel → TRAVELED (amerikacha, bitta 'L')
Enterprise — britancha kitob.

'BY plane' — transport 'by' bilan, artiklsiz.

items.sentence: 5  They/be/on holiday/last Monday  →  They have been on holiday ............ last Monday.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'last Monday' — ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

DIQQAT — CHALG'ITUVCHI:
  'FOR a week'      (davomiylik)
  'SINCE last week' (nuqta)
'last' so'zi ANIQ NUQTANI bildiradi.

ega 'They' → HAVE.
be → BEEN.
'ON HOLIDAY' — turg'un ibora, artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and follow the dialogue, then read it and put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. Listen again and check.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni tinglang va kuzating, so'ngra uni o'qing va qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. Yana tinglab tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: Pol va Piter MADRIDDA kutilmaganda
uchrashib qolishdi.

DIQQAT: dialog TO'LIQ bosilgan, shuning uchun
zamonlar matnning O'ZIDAN aniqlanadi —
audio faqat tekshirish uchun.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  HAVE YOU BEEN
   2  ARRIVED
   3  AM STAYING
   4  ARE YOU STAYING
   5  HAVE BEEN
   6  HAVE YOU VISITED
   7  HAVE ALREADY VISITED
   8  WENT
   9  SAW
  10  HAVE YOU BEEN
  11  WENT
  12  HAVE YOU BEEN
  13  AM GOING TO DO  (yoki WILL DO)
  14  WANT
  15  HAVE YOU TRIED
  16  WENT
  17  ARE YOU DOING
  18  AM GOING


TO'LIQ DIALOG (javoblar bilan):

  Paul:  Hello, Peter. What a surprise to meet
         you here in Madrid.
  Peter: Hey, Paul! Fancy meeting you here.
         This place is fantastic.
  Paul:  Yes, it is. How long HAVE YOU BEEN
         here?
  Peter: Oh, I ARRIVED last Saturday. I AM
         STAYING at the Monaco Hotel. Where
         ARE YOU STAYING?
  Paul:  With my friend Carlos. I HAVE BEEN
         here since last Monday.
  Peter: Which places HAVE YOU VISITED?
  Paul:  Well, I HAVE ALREADY VISITED the
         Prado Museum. I WENT there last
         Monday. It's fantastic. I SAW some
         beautiful paintings there. You really
         should go.
  Peter: I will, indeed. HAVE YOU BEEN to
         Palacio Real yet?
  Paul:  Yes, I WENT there yesterday. The
         state rooms were magnificent.
  Peter: That sounds nice. HAVE YOU BEEN
         shopping at all?
  Paul:  No, I haven't, but I AM GOING TO DO
         that soon. I WANT to go to the Rastro
         flea market to buy some souvenirs.
  Peter: That's a good idea. HAVE YOU TRIED
         paella yet?
  Paul:  Of course. I WENT to 'Lhardy'
         restaurant last night with some
         friends. The food was just delicious.
  Peter: I see you don't waste your time.
         What ARE YOU DOING tonight? Shall we
         go out for a drink?
  Paul:  I'd love to, but I can't. I AM GOING
         to the opera to see Carmen. But we
         can meet tomorrow.
  Peter: Okay, then. How about 7 o'clock at
         Bistro Café?
  Paul:  All right. See you tomorrow.
  Peter: See you.


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA GURUHLAR:

  PRESENT PERFECT (vaqt aytilmagan) — 6 ta:
     1, 5, 6, 7, 10, 12, 15

  PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt) — 4 ta:
     2 (last Saturday), 8 (last Monday),
     9, 11 (yesterday), 16 (last night)

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — 4 ta:
     3, 4 (vaqtinchalik holat),
     17, 18 (kelajakdagi reja)

  PRESENT SIMPLE — 1 ta:
     14 (want — his fe'li)

  BE GOING TO — 1 ta:
     13 (yaqin reja)


HAR BIRI NEGA — BATAFSIL:

 1  'HOW LONG ... you/be here?'
    KALIT: 'HOW LONG' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU BEEN

 2  'I ... (arrive) LAST SATURDAY.'
    KALIT: 'LAST SATURDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → ARRIVED

 3  'I ... (stay) at the Monaco Hotel.'
    Hozirgi VAQTINChALIK holat →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM STAYING
    ('I stay' — doimiy odat degan ma'no
     berardi)

 4  'Where ... (you/stay)?'
    3-band bilan bir xil savol shakli.
    → ARE YOU STAYING

 5  'I ... (be) here SINCE last Monday.'
    KALIT: 'SINCE' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE BEEN

 6  'Which places ... (you/visit)?'
    Vaqt aytilmagan, TAJRIBA so'ralyapti →
    PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU VISITED

 7  'I ... (ALREADY/visit) the Prado Museum.'
    KALIT: 'ALREADY' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    'already' — have va V3 ORASIDA.
    → HAVE ALREADY VISITED

 8  'I ... (go) there LAST MONDAY.'
    KALIT: 'LAST MONDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WENT

 9  'I ... (see) some beautiful paintings
     there.'
    8-band bilan bir xil vaqt (o'sha kun) →
    PAST SIMPLE.
    → SAW

10  '... (you/go) to Palacio Real YET?'
    KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU BEEN
    (Quyidagi izohga qarang.)

11  'Yes, I ... (go) there YESTERDAY.'
    KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WENT

12  '... (you/be) shopping at all?'
    Vaqt aytilmagan, TAJRIBA →
    PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU BEEN

13  'but I ... (do) that SOON.'
    KALIT: 'SOON' — kelajak.
    Keyingi gap ('I want to go to the
    Rastro') niyat borligini ko'rsatadi →
    BE GOING TO.
    → AM GOING TO DO
    ('I'LL DO that soon' ham to'g'ri —
     ayni damdagi qaror sifatida.)

14  'I ... (want) to go to the Rastro flea
     market.'
    'want' — HIS fe'li, Continuous
    BO'LMAYDI → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → WANT

15  '... (you/try) paella YET?'
    KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU TRIED

16  'I ... (go) to Lhardy restaurant LAST
     NIGHT.'
    KALIT: 'LAST NIGHT' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WENT

17  'What ... (you/do) TONIGHT?'
    Kelajakdagi REJA →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → ARE YOU DOING

18  'I ... (go) to the opera.'
    Aniq REJA (chipta bor) →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM GOING


⚠ 10-BAND HAQIDA MUHIM IZOH:

  Qavsda '(you/go)' yozilgan, lekin javob
  'HAVE YOU BEEN' bo'ladi.

  Nega? Chunki:
     'Have you GONE to Palacio Real?'
        = hali u yerdasizmi?
     'Have you BEEN to Palacio Real?'
        = borib qaytdingizmi?

  Pol javob beradi: 'Yes, I WENT there
  YESTERDAY' — ya'ni borib QAYTGAN.
  Shuning uchun 'BEEN' to'g'ri.

  Agar qavsni SO'ZMA-SO'Z bajarsak,
  'Have you gone' chiqadi — lekin bu
  ma'noga zid.

  Kitobning odatiy javobi: HAVE YOU BEEN.


⚠ ENG MUHIM NAQSh — 7 va 8-BANDLAR:

  'I HAVE ALREADY VISITED the Prado Museum.'
     (Present Perfect — vaqt yo'q)
  'I WENT there LAST MONDAY.'
     (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

  Xuddi 105-betdagi Jekning xatidagi kabi!
  Bu — Unit 15 ning asosiy darsi.


DIQQAT — 'HAVE YOU BEEN SHOPPING?':
  'to be shopping' emas, 'to GO shopping'.
  Lekin Present Perfect da:
     'Have you BEEN shopping?' ✓
  Bu — turg'un shakl.


DIQQAT — 'AT ALL':
  'Have you been shopping AT ALL?'
  'at all' — savolni kuchaytiradi
  ('umuman', 'biror marta bo'lsa ham').


DIALOGDAGI MADRID JOYLARI:
  the Prado Museum — Ispaniyaning bosh muzeyi
  Palacio Real — Qirollik saroyi
  the Rastro — Madridning mashhur yakshanba
     bozori (flea market — eski buyumlar
     bozori)
  'Lhardy' — 1839-yildan beri ishlaydigan
     mashhur restoran
  Carmen — Bize operasi


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  What a surprise!  = Qanday ajablanarli!
  Fancy meeting you here! = Sizni bu yerda
                    ko'rishimni qarang!
  a painting        = kartina, rasm
  indeed            = albatta, haqiqatan
  state rooms       = saroyning marosim xonalari
  magnificent       = ulug'vor
  at all            = umuman
  a flea market     = eski buyumlar bozori
  paella            = paelya (ispan taomi)
  to waste time     = vaqtni behuda o'tkazmoq
  Shall we ...?     = ...aylikmi?
  I'd love to       = juda xohlardim
  the opera         = opera
  How about ...?    = ... qanday bo'ladi?

items.sentence: 1  Paul: How long ................... (you/be) here?
items.uz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri turibsiz?

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HOW LONG' — bu savol DOIM
PRESENT PERFECT bilan (agar hozir ham davom
etayotgan bo'lsa).

105-bet, 4b-mashqda ham shu savol bor edi:
'How long HAS Jack BEEN there?'

items.sentence: 2  Peter: Oh, I ........................ (arrive) last Saturday.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST SATURDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

'I have arrived last Saturday' — XATO!
Aniq vaqt bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi.

items.sentence: 3  I ................... (stay) at the Monaco Hotel.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Hozirgi VAQTINCHALIK holat →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'I stay at the Monaco Hotel' — doimiy odat
degan ma'no berardi (har safar shu yerda
turaman).

Ta'til — vaqtinchalik, shuning uchun
'am staying'.

3-band bilan bir xil — VAQTINCHALIK holat
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

Savol shakli: ARE + ega + V-ing.

items.sentence: 5  Paul: With my friend Carlos. I ................... (be) here since last Monday.
items.uz: Do'stim Karlos bilan. O'tgan dushanbadan beri shu yerdaman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'SINCE' — Present Perfect ning
ko'rsatkichi.

'SINCE last Monday' = o'tgan dushanbadan beri
(boshlanish nuqtasi).

be → BEEN (V3).

items.sentence: 6  Peter: Which places ................... (you/visit)?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN — umumiy TAJRIBA so'ralyapti
→ PRESENT PERFECT.

105-bet, Speaking bo'limi bilan bir xil:
'HAS Jack VISITED the bazaar?'

items.sentence: 7  Paul: Well, I ................... (already/visit) the Prado Museum.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ALREADY' — Present Perfect ning
ko'rsatkichi.

'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
  'I have ALREADY visited' ✓
  'I have visited already' (kamroq)
  'ALREADY I have visited' ✗

items.sentence: 8  I ................... (go) there last Monday.
items.uz: O'tgan dushanba kuni u yerga bordim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST MONDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ 7 va 8-BANDLAR — UNIT 15 NING ASOSIY NAQSHI:
  7  'I HAVE ALREADY VISITED' (vaqt yo'q)
  8  'I WENT there LAST MONDAY' (aniq vaqt)

105-betdagi Jekning xati ham aynan shunday
tuzilgan.

go → WENT (V2).

items.sentence: 9  It's fantastic. I ................... (see) some beautiful paintings there.
items.uz: Ajoyib. U yerda bir necha go'zal kartina ko'rdim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
8-band bilan BIR XIL vaqtda (o'tgan dushanba)
→ PAST SIMPLE.

see → SAW (V2).

'a painting' = kartina, rasm.

items.sentence: 10  Peter: I will, indeed. ................... (you/go) to Palacio Real yet?

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' — Present Perfect ning
ko'rsatkichi.

⚠ MUHIM IZOH — NEGA 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS:
  'Have you GONE to ...?' = hali u yerdasizmi?
  'Have you BEEN to ...?' = borib qaytdingizmi?

Pol javob beradi: 'Yes, I WENT there
YESTERDAY' — ya'ni borib QAYTGAN.
Shuning uchun 'BEEN' to'g'ri.

Qavsda '(you/go)' yozilgan, lekin ma'no
'been' ni talab qiladi.

items.sentence: 11  Paul: Yes, I ................... (go) there yesterday.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

Yana o'sha naqsh: savol Present Perfect da
('Have you been ... yet?'), javob esa aniq
vaqt bilan Past Simple da.

items.sentence: 12  Peter: That sounds nice. ................... (you/be) shopping at all?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN, TAJRIBA so'ralyapti
→ PRESENT PERFECT.

'AT ALL' — savolni kuchaytiradi
('umuman', 'biror marta bo'lsa ham').

'to BE shopping' — Present Perfect da
turg'un shakl ('have you been shopping').

items.sentence: 13  Paul: No, I haven't, but I ................... (do) that soon.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'SOON' — kelajak.

Keyingi gap ('I WANT to go to the Rastro')
niyat ALLAQACHON borligini ko'rsatadi
→ BE GOING TO (reja).

DIQQAT: 'I'LL DO that soon' ham to'g'ri —
ayni damdagi qaror sifatida.
Ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi.

items.sentence: 14  I ................... (want) to go to the Rastro flea market to buy some souvenirs.
items.uz: Sovg'a olish uchun Rastro bozoriga bormoqchiman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'WANT' — HIS/XOHISH fe'li, Continuous
shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'I am wanting' — XATO!

Shu kabi fe'llar: like, love, hate, know,
understand, believe, need.

'a flea market' = eski buyumlar bozori.

items.sentence: 15  Peter: That's a good idea. ................... (you/try) paella yet?

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' — Present Perfect ning
ko'rsatkichi.

try → TRIED (y → i + ed).

'paella' — ispan taomi (guruch, dengiz
mahsulotlari, za'faron).

items.sentence: 16  Paul: Of course. I ................... (go) to 'Lhardy' restaurant last night with some friends.
items.uz: Albatta. O'tgan kecha do'stlarim bilan 'Lhardy' restoraniga bordim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST NIGHT' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

Yana o'sha naqsh (15-16 bandlar):
savol Present Perfect, javob Past Simple.

items.sentence: 17  Peter: What ................... (you/do) tonight?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Kelajakdagi REJA (aniq vaqt: 'tonight')
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

Unit 13 dan: aniq vaqtli reja → Present
Continuous.

Grammar 63-bet, 13-mashqda ham shu savol bor
edi: 'What ARE YOU DOING this evening?'

items.sentence: 18  Paul: I'd love to, but I can't. I ................... (go) to the opera to see Carmen.
items.uz: Juda xohlardim, lekin bo'lmaydi. Carmen operasiga boraman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Aniq REJA (ehtimol chipta ham bor)
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

17-band bilan mos: savol 'are you doing',
javob 'am going'.

'I'd love to' = juda xohlardim
('I would love to' qisqartmasi).
'Carmen' — Bize operasi.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SAVOL — HAMMASI POL HAQIDA.

DIQQAT: dialogda IKKI kishi bor, lekin
savollar faqat POL haqida.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  Where is Paul?
    → He is in Madrid.
    (U Madridda.)

 2  When did he arrive?
    → He arrived last Monday.
      (He has been there since last Monday.)
    (U o'tgan dushanba kuni keldi.)

 3  Where is he staying?
    → He is staying with his friend Carlos.
    (U do'sti Karlos bilan turibdi.)

 4  What places has he visited?
    → He has visited the Prado Museum and
      Palacio Real.
    (U Prado muzeyi va Palacio Real'ga
     borgan.)

 5  What hasn't he done yet?
    → He hasn't been shopping yet.
    (U hali xarid qilgani bormagan.)

 6  Where is he going tonight?
    → He is going to the opera to see Carmen.
    (U bugun kechqurun Carmen operasiga
     boradi.)


⚠ ENG NOZIK JOY — 2-SAVOL:

  Dialogda IKKI ta 'kelish' vaqti bor:
     PITER: 'I ARRIVED LAST SATURDAY.'
     POL:   'I have been here SINCE LAST
             MONDAY.'

  Savol POL haqida, shuning uchun javob
  'LAST MONDAY' bo'lishi kerak —
  'last Saturday' EMAS!

  Bu — mashqning eng ko'p adashtiradigan
  joyi. Kitob ataylab ikki sanani bergan.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR JAVOB DIALOGDA:

  1  →  Polning birinchi gapi:
        'to meet you here in MADRID'
  2  →  Pol: 'I have been here SINCE LAST
        MONDAY'
  3  →  Pol: 'WITH MY FRIEND CARLOS'
  4  →  Pol: 'the PRADO MUSEUM' +
        'PALACIO REAL' (kecha borgan)
  5  →  Pol: 'Have you been shopping at all?'
        'NO, I HAVEN'T'
  6  →  Pol: 'I am going TO THE OPERA to see
        CARMEN'


SAVOLNING ZAMONI JAVOBNING ZAMONINI
BELGILAYDI:

  'Where IS Paul?'          → 'He IS ...'
  'When DID he ARRIVE?'     → 'He ARRIVED ...'
  'Where IS he STAYING?'    → 'He IS STAYING ...'
  'What places HAS he       → 'He HAS VISITED ...'
   VISITED?'
  'What HASN'T he DONE?'    → 'He HASN'T ...'
  'Where IS he GOING?'      → 'He IS GOING ...'


DIQQAT — 4-SAVOLDA IKKI JOY:
  Pol IKKI joyga borgan:
     Prado Museum (o'tgan dushanba)
     Palacio Real (kecha)

  Ikkalasini ham aytish kerak.


DIQQAT — OLMOShLAR O'ZGARADI:
  Dialogda: 'I have been here'
  Javobda:  'HE has been there'

  'I' → 'he';  'here' → 'there';
  'my friend' → 'his friend'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to arrive   = yetib kelmoq
  to stay with = birovnikida turmoq
  tonight     = bugun kechqurun

points.en: 1  Where is Paul?  —  He is in Madrid.
points.uz: Pol qayerda? — U Madridda.
points.noteUz:
Dialogning birinchi gapidan:
'What a surprise to meet you here in MADRID.'

points.en: 2  When did he arrive?  —  He arrived last Monday. (He has been there since last Monday.)
points.uz: U qachon keldi? — O'tgan dushanba kuni.
points.noteUz:
⚠ ENG NOZIK JOY:

wordFormation.introUz: 107-bet — just, for/since, sayohat va Madrid lug'ati.

groups.explanationUz: Savol bering: QANCHA VAQT? yoki QACHONDAN BERI?

patterns.formula: HAVE + [ega] + [V3] ... YET?  —  Yes, ... have ALREADY [V3].  /  No, ... HAVEN'T [V3] ... YET.
patterns.exampleEn: Have they visited the Eiffel Tower yet? — Yes, they have already visited it. — No, they haven't been to Versailles yet.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular Eyfel minorasiga bordimi? — Ha, allaqachon borishgan. — Yo'q, hali Versalga borishmagan.
patterns.explanationUz:
YET — savol/inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.
ALREADY — tasdiqda, have va V3 ORASIDA.

patterns.formula: Have you [V3] ... YET?  —  Yes, I've JUST [V3] it/them/him.
patterns.exampleEn: Have you booked a table yet? — Yes, I've just booked it. Have you found the tickets yet? — Yes, I've just found them.
patterns.exampleUz: Stol band qildingizmi? — Ha, hozirgina. Chiptalarni topdingizmi? — Ha, hozirgina.
patterns.explanationUz:
JUST = hozirgina.
⚠ Olmoshga e'tibor: birlik → IT,
ko'plik → THEM, odam → HIM/HER.

patterns.exampleEn: He has lived in Rome for three years. I haven't travelled by plane since 1987.
patterns.exampleUz: U uch yildan beri Rimda yashaydi. 1987-yildan beri samolyotda uchmaganman.
patterns.explanationUz:
FOR + qancha vaqt; SINCE + qachondan beri.
INKOR gapda ham ishlatiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: How long have you been here? — Since last Monday. / For five days.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri turibsiz? — O'tgan dushanbadan beri. / Besh kundan beri.
patterns.explanationUz:
'How long' savoli DOIM Present Perfect bilan
(agar hozir ham davom etayotgan bo'lsa).

patterns.exampleEn: I have already visited the Prado Museum. I went there last Monday.
patterns.exampleUz: Prado muzeyiga allaqachon bordim. O'tgan dushanba kuni bordim.
